faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Elrena says, "While Zoth Uluus is no longer here, his spoilage remains to corrupt all life." "The unfathomable wall of sea that bore Zoth Uluus at its crest broke here upon the treetops. His darkness seeped into the forest soil and was soaked up by the verdant growth of the forest, giving it a twisted semblance of life." "These living vines creep and destroy what little left that is good. They must be cut back. Bring me their splintered twigs, and I will know of the right you have done." [ edit ] Objectives Travel northeast and slay any spoilcrawlers to be found. Gather their splintered twigs, and bring them to Elrena Faermil at the Recondite Threshold . Splintered Twig (40) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? faction lowered: Rotblood Troglodytes [ edit ] Description Mansel says, "It seems strange that the ceremony to reawaken Vol Tuniel could have gone so wrong. High elves are careful and scientific, even in their religious ceremonies." "The elves here at the Threshold suspect that those who performed the ceremony must have suffered an attack - perhaps another god acted to prevent Vol Tuniel from rising." "You must take notes from more books deep in the east side of the temple. Also, collect remnant ashes from urns, and I will examine them for magical residue." [ edit ] Objectives Search deep in the east side of the temple of Vol Tuniel for urns with ashes remaining in them. Also take notes from two specific books: the Ceremonial Tome and the Monograph of Divination . Return to Mansel Nott at the Recondite Threshold . Take Notes from the Monograph of Divination Take Notes from the Ceremonial Tome Remnant Ashes (5) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ?
